transcript: In Scarlet and Violet, through Terrestrializing, Scissor will not only be able to bolster its defenses, but it will become one of the most powerful Pokemon in these new titles. Scissor Terrestrializing into a pure Steel-type not only reduces that horrible Fire-type weakness from a 4x weakness to a 2x weakness, it also gives Scissor a 2x stab or same-type attack bonus on all its Steel-type attacks. Scissor also has access to the ability Technician, which doubles the base power of all moves with a 60 base power or below. And combining that with a plus 1 priority Steel-type attack Bullet Punch, Swift Technician goes from a 40 base power to an 80 base power attack. If you also attach a Choice Buying Item on top of this with an Adamant Nature and 2-5-2 attacking EVs, you are looking at one of the most powerful Pokemon to exist within these games. Look at this calculation against a standard Hydreigon, and you can see that the minimum damage is a 93% chance to pick up a one-hit kill from a Bullet Punch on this Scissor.
metadata_caption: SCIZOR WILL BE OP!! Pokemon Scarlet and Violet
